title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
hook_text: Robotics is still in its Lego era
hook_before: Robotics is currently in its Lego era.
script:
Seven years at Nvidia taught Amulya Vishwanath one truth.
Amulya Vishwanath spent seven years at Nvidia.
She led product marketing for Nvidia's robotics platforms.
Basic building blocks like actuators and robotic hands are still being rebuilt.
General foundation models have not yet unlocked a total robotics revolution.
Safety standards and software must catch up to the current hardware.
Will physical robots ever be as smart as your phone?
